en.headline: Exotic Pets World at Hopewell Mall enters final day on Tuesday
en.dek: The free pop-up in Wan Chai has showcased more than 15 rare species including axolotls, an Aldabra giant tortoise and a critically endangered iguana since late July.
body: The Exotic Pets World pop-up at Hopewell Mall in Wan Chai is scheduled to close on Tuesday after a run that began on 25 July.

Organised across four themed zones on the third-floor atrium, the free exhibition has displayed more than 15 exotic species, among them the critically endangered Lesser Antillean iguana, an Aldabra giant tortoise and axolotls. An aquatic section curated with local expertise features crustaceans and freshwater displays, while a conservation zone highlights the Chinese crocodile lizard.

Interactive workshops such as insect specimen mounting and a Little Zoologist programme for children aged seven and above have required separate registration. The mall said all animals are sourced in compliance with relevant legislation and permits.

zh.headline: 合和商場另類寵物世界明日結束 展出逾15種異寵
zh.dek: 灣仔合和商場三樓中庭的免費展覽自7月25日起展出極危小安德烈斯島鬣蜥、阿爾達布拉巨龜及美西螈等物種。
body: 灣仔合和商場「另類寵物世界」免費展覽將於周二結束，活動自7月25日開始。
展覽設於商場三樓中庭，劃分四個主題區，展出超過15種異寵，包括被列為極危的小安德烈斯島鬣蜥、阿爾達布拉巨龜及美西螈。水族及甲殼區由本地專家參與策展，另設保育展區展示瑤山鱷蜥模型。
場內設有昆蟲標本製作等互動工作坊，以及面向7歲或以上兒童的「小小動物學家」課程，須另行登記。商場表示所有展出動物均符合法例及持有相關許可。
